_about: J. Wight Duff (John Wight Duff, 1866-1944), Professor of Classics at Armstrong College, Newcastle. Classical scholarship (lane B). Clean Gutenberg: A Literary History of Rome in the Silver Age, from Tiberius to Hadrian (London: T. Fisher Unwin, 1927). Raw IA OCR: A Literary History of Rome from the Origins to the Close of the Golden Age (London: T. Fisher Unwin, 1909; Toronto scan) and The Writers of Rome (Oxford University Press, Humphrey Milford, 1923; preface dated December 1923, title-page year misread by the OCR). Not taken: Roman Satire (1936) and the Loeb Minor Latin Poets (1934), after the cutoff; the Indian-library Silver Age scans, which are the 1964 third edition. Not J. D. Duff (Lucan, Herzen), whose translator shelf is jd-duff. US public domain. No uids minted.
